messages:
Emily (CEO): Quick weekly — huge thanks to everyone pushing Private GA forward. Three asks this week: 1) bring down 99th%-ile latency on dedicated pools (we're targeting <450ms for typical gen workloads), 2) decide EU private-beta data retention default, 3) reduce unit costs on hosted inference by ~12% without degrading quality. Short notes and owners below.

Ravi (VP Eng): On latency — infra is running a canary kernel tweak tonight. Early signs look promising on 8k contexts. I'll post before/after numbers in this thread. Link to perf dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/latency (internal)

Ravi (VP Eng): Suggestion for fallback policy: if tail latency > 500ms for >5m, route new requests to quantized variant + smaller batch sizing. That would keep P95 low while preserving throughput. Need product & SRE sign-off.

Maya (Head of Product): For EU private beta retention — Legal is leaning to 30d, Ops wants 7d for cost. My recommendation: default = 14d (opt-in longer retention for enterprise customers). I'll draft the UI copy and the admin toggle.

Sam (Finance): Re: 12% cost reduction — Finance will share a prioritized list of low-value features we can delay (long-term cache retention, some debug logs). Ops and Product: please confirm which items are safe to trim this quarter.

ops-bot: Deploy started: private-ga/canary v1.3 -> infra-prod at 2025-06-10T22:14Z :rocket: (track: #deploys)

Chen (SRE): Noted on fallback policy. Also filing a short postmortem for last night's KV cache spike; root cause was prefix-eviction mis-tuning. Mitigation: revert eviction thresholds + patch pushed. Postmortem link will be up by EOD.

Ash (DevRel): Comms ask — if we change retention defaults for EU beta we'll need a short customer-facing note and an FAQ. I can draft a one-paragraph email + in-product banner. Need final wording from Legal/Product.

Emily (CEO): @Maya please formalize 14d default and share the exact admin wording by tomorrow noon. @Ravi coordinate the fallback thresholds and the canary metrics; pin results here. @Chen drop the PM for the incident. @Ash go ahead on the comms draft; use #marketing template. I'll host a 30-min sync tomorrow 9am PST to resolve open items — calendar invite sent.

Ravi (VP Eng): Will do. I'll add canary metrics and a small table to this thread with P50/P95/P99 after the night run.

Emily (CEO): TL;DR: three asks — 1) latency SLO work (owner: Ravi), 2) EU retention default = 14d (owner: Maya), 3) 12% cost reduction plan (owner: Sam + Ops/Product). Post blockers and must-have follow-ups by EOD. Thanks all :handshake:
